Commentary.Commentary: Done for the night. At last some fight shown by Bangladesh on this tour, however the end result remained unchanged. They will have one more shot before flying back home. Can they avoid yet another clean sweep? Do join us on Sunday at 1430 local (1230 GMT) for the 2nd T20I which will take place in Potchefstroom. Cheers!

Man of the Match, AB de Villiers states that Jonty Rhodes has inspired him the most. Is disappointed to have gotten out early as he wanted to get a big one. Further says when he stepped out, de Kock informed him that there is pace on the wicket and that is when he decided to cash in. Reckons he enjoys batting at no. 3 in this format as it helps to construct the innings accordingly. Adds he wanted to make the debutant Robbie Frylinck feel better as he was nervous at the start and is happy to take a catch off his bowling to calm him down.

Protea skipper, JP Duminy says that they posted a good score. Mentions that the opposition bowlers at the death were on the money but it was skillful batting from Miller and Behardien to take them to 195. Credits his bowlers for being calm when the Bangladeshi batsmen were on the attack. Informs that he is happy with his bowlers. Adds that their variations were good but there is always room for improvement. Ends by saying that they need to be ruthless and keep giving their best.

Bangladesh skipper, Shakib Al Hasan starts by saying South Africa batted really well but feels the last 5 overs while bowling cost them the match. Opines they gave away 20-30 extra which they could have stopped. Adds they got a good start but just couldn't capitalize on it. Rues the fielding which wasn't up to the mark either. Is impressed with the way the spinners bowled. Hopes to rectify the mistakes they committed today and ends by saying they would keep in mind that they don't face too many dot balls further.

Credit to the inexperienced South African bowlers for holding their nerves when they were put under pressure. They bounced back tremendously and made Bangladesh slip from 2/92. All their speedsters bagged a couple of wickets apiece with Paterson and Phehlukwayo standing out the most. Mohammad Saifuddin fought a lone battle towards the end but his knock only helped the visiting team to narrow down the defeat margin.

Scintillating batting by the likes of de Kock, de Villiers and Behardien powered South Africa to a big total. However, the Bangla Tigers didn't lose hope. The shortest format brought out the tiger in them and they responded brilliantly at the start. Soumya Sarkar looked in fine form, playing attractive and attacking brand of cricket but the other batters were not quite up to the mark. Plenty of starts were wasted as the Protea bowlers kept chipping away at the wickets.

Entertaining contest! Unlike the Test and ODI series, Bangladesh fought hard but sadly for them, it wasn't enough. Anyway, they will be pleased to see some improvement in their performance and would like to better it in the last game on this tour.

SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 20 RUNS! On middle and leg, Saifuddin jams it down to long on and hares back for a couple. What a win for the Proteas, the crowd is up on its feet lauding the effort displayed by Duminy and his boys to take a 1-0 LEAD IN THE SERIES!

FOUR! Sloppy from Behardien! Slower back of the hand delivery outside off, Saifuddin makes room and slaps it over covers. Behardien in the deep is a bit sloppy and allows the ball to run away through to the fence.
Slower length ball on middle, Hossain flat-bats it down to long on for a single.
In the air... drops well short! Saifuddin opts to pull this slower ball but gets a top edge. The ball falls well short of the man running in from deep square leg. A single taken.
SIX! Boom! Fuller in length and on the pads, Saifuddin clears the front leg and just whips it over deep square leg to pick up a maximum.
Fuller in length on off, driven towards de Villiers at covers. They set off and ABD has a shy at the bowler's end. He hits but the batsman was safely in.
Short delivery on middle, Saifuddin ducks under it. Paterson's spell comes to an end as well.
Low full toss on the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
Into the blockhole, Saifuddin digs it out to long on for a couple of runs.
MS was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Once again keeps it full on the stumps, Saifuddin slogs it off the inner half behind square on the leg side for a couple.
Spears in a yorker at the base of the stumps, Saifuddin jams it out.
Frylinck finishes his spell with figures of 4-0-33-2! Decent debut. Slower delivery on middle, defended by Rubel.
Slower delivery on the pads, flicked through square leg for a single.
Wide! Sprays one down the leg side, Saifuddin misses his attempted flick shot. De Kock behind the stumps fails to collect it cleanly. He is having an off day behind the stumps.
Mohammad Saifuddin makes room, Frylinck follows him. He tries to put bat on ball but misses it completely.
FOUR! Length ball, angling in, Saifuddin muscles it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Rubel Hossain is the last man in!

OUT! Knuckle ball works for Frylinck! Islam makes room to hit that one over the off side but gets it off the toe-end of the bat. Miller from covers runs backwards and takes a smart catch. South Africa just a wicket away from winning this!
Backs away and drills it through point for a single.
Back of the hand delivery outside off, Islam swings and misses. 3 runs and  two wickets, what an over!
Slower ball on the pads, tucked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Almost... almost a hat-trick! Spears in a yorker, swinging back in, Islam manages to jam it out off the inner half towards square leg for a single.
Shafiul Islam is the new man in to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Two-in-two for Paterson! Another successful review from South Africa! Paterson fires in a pinpoint yorker on the stumps, Taskin seems to be a tad late in bringing his bat down. The ball goes off the front boot towards the off side. Paterson appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Duminy immediately takes the review. The TV umpire takes a lot of time to confirm if it was bat or boot first and eventually makes the decision that it's boot. Hawk Eye then confirms it's pitched in line and would have crashed into the stumps. Can Paterson pick up a hat-trick?
Review time! Duminy straightaway goes for a review against Ahmed. The only thing which can save him is if there is bat involved.
Taskin Ahmed is the new man in!
OUT! Bowled 'em! Mehedi Hasan walks across to play the scoop but that leads to his undoing! The ball hits the pads and then deflects back onto the leg stump. Paterson is elated!
Back of a length on middle, tapped towards the on side for a single.

SIX! Mehedi Hasan has given it his all! Slower back from the hand delivery on middle, Mehedi Hasan backs away and pulls hard at it. Didn't seem like he has got enough but indeed he did to clear Duminy at long on for a maximum.
Low full toss angling in, MS looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards cover. AB de Villiers fumbles and a single is taken.
Saifuddin defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Edged and over point! Backs away and throws his hands at it. Gets an outside edge over point. No one in the deep and Mehedi collects a boundary.
Hasan makes room, the bowler follows him. Mehedi awkwardly pulls it through the leg side to collect one.
Outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Andile Phehlukwayo returns for a bowl.
Good length delivery on middle, flicked through the leg side for a single.
Comes down the track to go for a big hit but ends up miscuing it off the outer half over covers for a single.
Fuller delivery on the pads, flicked towards short fine leg for a single.
Slower length ball outside off, pushed in front of point for a single.
Slower delivery, it's the knuckle ball. Mehedi is deceived by it and the ball hits the splice of the bat. Luckily, it falls well short of the man coming in from point.
FOUR! Just used the pace on the ball! Short of a length delivery outside off, Hasan stands in the crease and opens the face of the bat at the last moment to get it past point for a boundary.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Mehedi Hasan is the next man in!

OUT! Sabbir Rahman departs after playing a good hand! Clever change in pace by Hendricks! Slower back of the hand delivery on middle, Sabbir Rahman makes room and tries to flat-bat it. However, he ends up miscuing it high in the air behind the bowler. Phehlukwayo from covers comes sprinting across to his right and takes an excellent catch. Another big blow.
Rahman gives the charge, the bowler spots it and hence fires it full outside off. The batsman could do nothing about it.
SIX! What a hit that is! Back of a length delivery on middle, Sabbir stands tall and just lofts it down the ground over long on. He has hit that so well that it goes all the way over the fence.
Fuller outside off, Sabbir has a swing and a miss at it.
Shortish on middle, Rahman mistimes his pull back to the bowler.
Beuran Hendricks is back on!
Around middle and leg, worked around the corner for a single.
Good length ball on middle, punched down to long on for a single.
Wide! The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire signals a wide.

What an effort from AB de Villiers, saves five runs for his team! My word, this man is a superman! Sabbir once again steps out and swings across the line. The ball is destined to sail over the deep mid-wicket fence but.... AB de Villiers out of nowhere comes across to his left, times his leap to perfection and parries it back into play. Could have taken the catch but the momentum was taking him beyond the rope and hence he released the ball. Brilliant!
SIX! Boom! Tossed up delivery around middle, Sabbir comes down the track and bludgeons it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. Bangladesh need many more of these shots.
Once again it's hit down to long on. Call is for two but Saifuddin slips at the bowler's end so only one taken.
Flatter one on middle, punched down to long on. Some good running between the wickets allows them to come back for a couple.
Full toss on off, the batsman clips it through mid-wicket and calls for two. But he will have to settle for one.
Length delivery on middle, tucked through backward square leg for a single.
On a fuller length outside off, flicked through mid on for one. Saifuddin is off the mark.
Low full toss on middle, driven towards mid on for a single.
Mohammad Saifuddin is the new man in!

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Phehlukwayo adds another one to his wicket tally. Back of a length delivery, angling in, Mahmudullah comes down the track to play it across the line but there is some extra bounce and as a result he gets a top edge on this one. The ball balloons high in the air where Amla settles under it at backward point. Half the Bangla side back in the hut!
On a length and outside off, Mahmudullah tries to use the pace and dab it away but fails to get any wood on it.
Once again charges down the track and flicks it through wide mid on for a single. Bangladesh need 95 from 54 balls!
Mahmudullah gives the charge and lofts it over the bowler's head for a couple.
Mahmudullah walks in next!

OUT! Dolly for de Villiers! Bangladesh are losing the plot now. Phangiso slows it through the air, lands it full outside off. Rahim gets down to slog sweep it but doesn't get enough meat behind the shot. Goes straight down the throat of ABD at deep mid-wicket who doesn't drop many.
Darts it around middle, Rahim misses it completely and is hit on the pads.
Gets to the pitch of the ball and works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, pushed towards cover.
Yorker on middle, SR jams it out over the leaping bowler for a single. Successful over from Andile this!
Wide! Wayward from Phehlukwayo! Once again sprays it down leg, left alone by Sabbir.
Sabbir comes down the track, Andile digs it short. The batsman awkwardly plays it towards cover.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller and aiming the stumps, Rahman drives it towards mid off to get off the mark.
Wide! Short delivery, down leg, Sabbir looks to pull but misses.
Shortish outside off, tapped towards point.
Sabbir Rahman is the new man in!

OUT! Got him... yes gone! The on-field call has to be overturned! Excellent use of the review and South Africa are right back in this! Duminy brings Phehlukwayo into the attack and gets the reward! He comes from around the wicket and angles it in on middle. Sarkar comes a couple of steps down the track to work it away but misses and is rapped on the pads. A huge appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Duminy has a word with his bowler and then takes the DRS! Front foot is absolutely fine and there is no inside edge either. Hawk Eye shows it's pitched in line and would have hit the leg pole. That's it! Sarkar's breezy knock has been cut short as he misses out on a well-deserved fifty.
Sarkar is looking quite adjacent in front. He will be very lucky to get away here...
Review! South Africa have taken a review for an LBW against Sarkar here.
Andile Phehlukwayo is called back into the attack!

FOUR! What a shot! He's picking his spots here! Gets into the position early and reverse sweeps it right between backward point and short third man to end the over with a boundary. The Bangladesh fans in the crowd are loving it. 13 off the over!
Drags the length short, Soumya tucks it through wide mid on for a single.

SIX! Down the track and away she goes! Loops it up around middle and leg, Sarkar comes dancing down the track and belts it over mid-wicket for a maximum. He has nailed it and is inching closer to a fifty here.
Shimmies down the track and works it down to long on for a single.
Sinks low and sweeps it towards deep square leg for just a single.
Loopy delivery on the pads, swept straight to short fine leg by Sarkar.
Aaron Phangiso comes into the attack now!
SIX! That's gone the distance! The little man has smoked it and I am not even kidding! Sees the flight, Rahim gets down and murders the slog sweep over mid-wicket for half a dozen.
Loops it up around off, Rahim makes room but drives it straight to cover.
Tossed up delivery around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
FIVE WIDES! Fires one down the leg side, Sarkar gets down to broom it away but misses and so does the keeper. Bonus runs for Bangladesh!
Flatter on middle, Sarkar looks to cut but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Steps out and flicks it wide of long on for a brace.
Loopy ball around middle, eased through mid on for a single.
Mushfiqur Rahim walks in next! Also, JP Duminy brings himself into the attack!

OUT! Maiden international wicket for Robbie! But this is a fantastic catch from AB de Villiers! He is all pumped up as Shakib departs! Back of a length delivery on off, Shakib steps out to go after it but this one bounces a bit more and hence he ends up getting a big top edge over covers. De Villiers from extra cover calls for it. Keeps running backwards, has his eyes set on the ball and then stretches both his hands to gobble it. Not an easy take that, but he made it look easy.
Beaten! Tries to slog it across the line but Robbie nicely changes the pace to get the better of the batsman.
FOUR! He is on the charge now! This is off the middle! Good length delivery on middle, Shakib rocks back and pulls it off the meat of the bat through mid-wicket. Nearly carried all the way.
FOUR! Good shot! Length delivery on middle, Shakib backs away, waits for the ball and then whacks it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Doesn't even bother running!
Slower delivery on the pads, clipped towards short fine leg for a single.
That must have stung! Back of a length delivery on middle, Sarkar winds up to play a pull shot but this one skids a touch and hits him near the stomach area.

Swing and a miss! Length delivery around middle and off, the Bangla skipper walks down the track and gives it a full swing of the bat but is beaten all ends up. End of the Powerplay, Bangladesh are 55/1!
Steps out to this length delivery and smacks it through covers for a single.
Gets across and paddles it towards short fine leg for a single.
On the pads, flicked towards the man at 45 for a single.
Driven straight to the man at cover.

LBW appeal, not given! Andile hurls a length delivery on the stumps, Sarkar looks to nudge it away but misses and is hit on the pads. Phehlukwayo appeals long and hard but the umpire stays put. Duminy has a word with his mates regarding the review but de Kock is the one who says not to go upstairs. Good call from the keeper as Hawk Eyes shows it's pitching outside leg.
Andile Phehlukwayo comes into the attack now!
FOUR! Shakib is off the mark! Fuller ball in the zone, Shakib clears his front leg and lofts it cleanly down the ground for a boundary to end the over.
Slower delivery around middle, pushed towards cover for a single.
FOUR! That's not what you would want to bowl! Shortish on middle and leg, Sarkar shuffles and pulls it down to fine leg for a boundary.
Slower delivery, angling away, Sarkar tries to be deft here, he looks to run it down but gets beaten due to lack of pace on it. Three dot balls!
Back of a length on middle, tucked towards the left of the bowler.
Slower delivery around middle, Sarkar comes down the track and defends it back down the wicket.
Robbie Frylinck, the debutant comes on to bowl. Let's see if he can have a great debut!
Short ball on middle and off, Shakib tries to ramp it over the keeper but fails to get any wood on it. 10 runs and a wicket from the over!
The skipper, Shakib Al Hasan strides out to bat next!

OUT! Gone! That's a soft dismissal! Hendricks doles out a low full toss down the leg side, Kayes could have played a better shot but he ends up flicking it straight to deep square leg where Miller takes a comfortable catch. Kayes would be kicking himself at the moment. South Africa are happy, they have drawn first blood.
Shortish on middle, pulled down to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! More runs! This is even better! Good length delivery outside off, Sarkar lofts it cleanly over extra cover. Once it clears the infield, there is no stopping that one.

FOUR! Beautiful shot! Shortish around middle and leg, Sarkar stands tall and just clips it over backward square leg for a one bounce boundary. He punches the air in joy after playing that shot! Maybe, he anticipated that this was coming!
On a length and outside off, Kayes goes after it but ekes out an edge down to third man for one.
Fuller in length on middle, Imrul drives it down the ground but the bowler manages to get some hand on it. The ball rolls towards mid on and a single is taken. 13 off the over!

Once again Quinton fumbles! Never seen him struggling with the mitts this much! Sprayed down the leg side, SS tries clipping it away but fails to do so. De Kock once again dives to his right but fails to collect it cleanly which allows them to get a single. Two wides!
FOUR! Easy as it gets! Short ball on the hips, Sarkar moves across and helps it with a pull down to fine leg for a boundary. He's got a start here!
Shortish on middle, defended from within the crease.

Edgyy! Back of a length delivery around off, Soumya looks to defend but the ball takes the outer part of the bat and flies quickly down to third man. The call is for two and they take it easily in the end.
FOUR! Good shot! Touch short on middle, comes at a good height too. Sarkar swivels a touch and plays a controlled pull shot through mid-wicket for a boundary. Amla in the deep gives it up halfway.
What bounce! Short of a length delivery, angling away, Sarkar looks to pull it away but is beaten for pace and bounce.
A loud shout for an LBW! Fires in a fuller ball on middle and leg, Sarkar shuffles a touch to flick but wears it on the pads. They take a leg bye.
Fuller around the pads, clipped in front of square leg for a single.

Two wides! Sprays one down the leg side, Soumya tries clipping it away but the ball is away from his reach. De Kock dives to his right to collect but it deflects off his gloves towards fine leg. They take a run.
SIX! Bangggg! Ahead of a length, angling in, Sarkar stays put and swings it high and over long on for a maximum. Sarkar was trying to play one and he finally connects.

What happened to de Kock there? Seems to have hurt his right hand after catching that one! Short ball, down the leg, Sarkar tries to pull it away but there is more bounce and hence he gets beaten. De Kock leaps to collect it and immediately rings his right hand in pain.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Imrul stands tall and steers it down to third man for a single.
Fuller in length from over the wicket, Kayes tries to clip it away but misses and it goes off the pads towards square leg.
Beuran Hendricks will bowl from the other end!
Good length delivery outside off, Kayes slashes at it but gets it off the outer half to third man. A run taken. 9 from the first over.
That one zipped through! Bouncer on leg stump, Kayes goes for the hook but misses.
Nicely played! Shortish delivery on middle and leg, Sarkar helps it away through in front of square leg. Miller chases it and slides near the fence to keep the ball in play. Saves a run for his side.
Back of a length delivery in line of the stumps, Kayes tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes off. Miller attacks the ball, dives and has a shy at the bowler's end but the throw is way off target.
On a length on off, Kayes hangs back and keeps it out.
FOUR! Perfect start for Bangladesh! Fullish delivery on off, Kayes extends his arms and lifts it over mid off for a boundary.

We are back for the chase. The South African coach, Ottis Gibson is having a word with the debutant, Robbie Frylinck. Soumya Sarkar and Imrul Kayes to open the batting for Bangladesh. It will be Dane Paterson who will steam in with the new ball. A slip in place. Here we go...
